description: HOLD-OUT SET. 60 synthetic questions, ten per intent, half English and half casual Indonesian, generated with ChatGPT on 12 October 2026 from the six intent definitions only (no rules, no examples, no knowledge base). Generated after the keyword rules and the training examples were frozen. Never loaded into the database and never used to change a rule or an example: kb/evaluate-chat.mjs classifies them once and the figure is reported as it is.
